User is planning a dinner party with spicy mango margaritas. Appetizers: grilled pineapple–prosciutto skewers and spicy shrimp ceviche (lime, mango, jalapeño). Main: grilled jerk chicken with mango salsa; sides: grilled asparagus and roasted sweet potatoes replacing quinoa. Season sweet potatoes with olive oil, salt, pepper, aromatics, and citrus. Dessert: coconut-lime panna cotta with dessert-friendly mango salsa (more ripe mango, little/no jalapeño, balanced lime, optional honey/agave, salt; mint/basil/cilantro). User enjoys experimenting with jerk seasoning.

For a Friday cocktail-making class, user is excited to try a Paloma and Tequila Sour, especially experimenting with grapefruit juice and egg-white texture. They also plan a Watermelon Basil Margarita using roasted watermelon puree, basil syrup, lime, agave, salt rim, and Avion Silver—already a favorite tequila used in homemade margaritas. User has previously mentioned a class on Thursday, but their current stated class day is Friday.
